note: Decision 362: Fatigue — what a long night does to your body, beside Strain (the mind). 0–6, three bands; only the worse of Fatigue and Strain counts on a check. Gains come from the app (each fight's end, a long or bloody fight, a Push, a stim's crash) and the GM (a night without sleep, a forced march). Relief: a breather (−2, once per scene — the GM's safe New scene or Breather), sleep or downtime (back to 0), stims (−2 now, but the next breather won't help).
